name: Diamond recovery / three-line plant
description: Single-image SAM2/Idol component Gaussian reconstruction from the original synthetic plant photograph. Repeated modules share reconstructed appearances; metric placement, connectivity and telemetry remain authored assumptions. Unreconstructed modules retain explicitly authored mesh models. Gaussian screening is not semantic accuracy certification.
